grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and current details before processing your passport name change

grants.description: Share your current passport details and history with HMPO
grants.purpose: To validate your existing passport and link it to your new application

grants.description: Upload your marriage certificate, civil partnership certificate, or deed poll as evidence of name change
grants.purpose: To verify your legal name change and update passport records accordingly

grants.description: Provide a digital photo that meets passport photo requirements for your new passport
grants.purpose: Your photo will be printed on your new passport card

grants.description: Process your payment for the passport name change application
grants.purpose: To process the £94.50 fee for online applications (£107 for paper applications)

grants.description: Share copies of any valid foreign passports you hold
grants.purpose: UK law requires disclosure of foreign nationality status for passport applications

grants.description: Participate in a video interview if required for identity verification
grants.purpose: Some applications require a video interview to confirm identity and prevent fraud

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMPO Passport Adviceline or revoke through your GOV.UK account before submission
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled and payment refunded if consent is revoked before final submission. After submission, withdrawal may not be possible and fees may not be refunded.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payment on your behalf. Agent cannot upload your photo without your explicit approval. Agent cannot complete video interview on your behalf. Agent cannot sign the declaration confirming accuracy of information - you must do this yourself.
